parameters.content:
## Sheet Poller (Keystone)
Every 5 minutes: reads Airtable My Clients for every Active client with Invoicing on and a Jobs sheet ID, reads each client's Jobs tab, and sends rows with status = "Complete" (with the clientId) to the main Invoice Automation webhook. Rows that error or need review are written back to the sheet AND emailed to Bilal.

nodes.name: Process Complete Rows
nodes.notes: Calls the main workflow's own already-tested webhook per qualifying row (now including paymentMethod, passed through unchanged from whatever the sheet cell contains - blank/unexpected values are handled by the main workflow's own 'Normalize Payment Method' node, not here), sequentially (awaited one at a time - deliberately not parallel, to avoid concurrent Xero calls racing). Builds a Sheets values.update range (columns I-M: status, invoiceReference, invoiceNumber, processedAt, errorMessage) per row for the next node - shifted one column right from the original H-L now that Payment Method occupies column H. Assumes the exact Jobs tab column order from the README - if that ever changes, update the column letters here.

nodes.name: Update Row
nodes.notes: One PUT per qualifying row (n8n's default per-item HTTP Request behavior) - fine at the expected small volume of jobs per poll. alwaysOutputData: true so a poll with zero qualifying rows still reaches Build Poll Summary instead of silently producing no output (same zero-items gotcha found earlier in the phone booking build).
